prBody:
## Summary

Families currently keep boards and saved media only on each device, so reinstalling or moving devices can lose their library. This adds optional Firebase sign-in and consent-based backup to the selected server, preserving guest use, offline playback and local boards after sign-out.

Backups validate media with SHA-256, preserve conflicting edits, enforce quotas and retry interrupted deletion. Browser sessions use HttpOnly cookies; native credentials use SecureStore. The accounts migration follows the landed PostgreSQL foundation. Account requests stay pinned to the consented server, including during development.

Closes #19. Replaces the accounts work in #24 directly on master, without the deferred OAuth grants in #20. Those branches and their historical evidence remain preserved.

## Test plan and behavior evidence

| Scenario | Expected and observed result |
| --- | --- |
| Create an account, verify email, then sign in on a fresh browser | Explicit consent precedes backup; verification gates sync; boards and photo/picture/speech bytes restore exactly. Three real account-browser scenarios passed. |
| Disconnect during sync, then reconnect | Local boards remain intact; reconnect completes sync. Browser tests also passed offline conflict-copy, sign-out and account/server-isolation cases. |
| Upgrade the foundation database; corrupt media; race revisions/quotas; interrupt deletion | Prior migration ledger is preserved, unsafe writes are rejected and deletion work stays durable. All 25 PostgreSQL17/Auth-emulator contracts passed. |

### Before / After

Before is actual master `842ac7f`; After is the account-only head `88fd6b0`. Matched synthetic library, fresh second-device storage, 1180×1050, scale 1, light theme and shared clock. No UI hiding or image edits. Baseline navigation differs because master has no account action.

**Consent:** After explains what uploads, server access and how to continue without signing in.

| Before: no account consent | After: explicit backup consent |
| --- | --- |
| ![Before: master Parent settings](https://github.com/MChartier/little-say/blob/5731b0dafacd0553b538c3f9d824348c75ce92b5/before-consent-unavailable.png?raw=true) | ![After: backup disclosure and consent](https://github.com/MChartier/little-say/blob/5731b0dafacd0553b538c3f9d824348c75ce92b5/after-backup-consent.png?raw=true) |

**Restore:** the fresh master device has no saved boards; After restores the verified account library. Blank-looking thumbnails are deliberate tiny synthetic media; restored bytes were asserted exactly.

| Before: fresh guest device | After: restored account library |
| --- | --- |
| ![Before: no saved boards](https://github.com/MChartier/little-say/blob/5731b0dafacd0553b538c3f9d824348c75ce92b5/before-fresh-device.png?raw=true) | ![After: Farmyard friends restored](https://github.com/MChartier/little-say/blob/5731b0dafacd0553b538c3f9d824348c75ce92b5/after-restored-device.png?raw=true) |

**Recovery, both at After:** offline sync reports failure without losing boards; reconnect completes sync. This supplements the master-to-head comparisons.

| After: offline failure | After: recovered |
| --- | --- |
| ![After: boards retained during failure](https://github.com/MChartier/little-say/blob/5731b0dafacd0553b538c3f9d824348c75ce92b5/after-offline-retry.png?raw=true) | ![After: all boards and assets synced](https://github.com/MChartier/little-say/blob/5731b0dafacd0553b538c3f9d824348c75ce92b5/after-recovered.png?raw=true) |

[Immutable source/build/fixture provenance, reproduction and full scope](https://github.com/MChartier/little-say/blob/5731b0dafacd0553b538c3f9d824348c75ce92b5/README.md). Nonempty actually loaded bundles matched both isolated builds.

## Supporting checks and limitations

[Current-head CI](https://github.com/MChartier/little-say/actions/runs/37501992018) passed. Release/type checks, 228 unit tests, 73 guest/offline browser scenarios, server/web builds and Android JavaScript export passed. Real Google/Apple authorization and hardware SecureStore remain unverified; synthetic identities and export are not provider/device proof. No provider setup or deployment is included. Independent QA and authenticated GitHub image rendering remain pending; the prior PR20/24 rendering waiver does not cover this replacement.
